text:
# Pre-market brief, Wed 2026-11-11 (~8:20 AM ET)

1. **AI relief bid.** As of 6:39 AM ET, S&P E-minis +0.86%, Nasdaq-100 +1.9%, Dow +0.11% after CoreWeave's beat-and-raise ([Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/sp-500-nasdaq-futures-rise-after-coreweave-soothes-ai-spending-fears-5018288)). CRWV +11–17% pre: Q3 rev $3.66B vs $3.55B, FY26 rev guide $13.0–13.3B, adj op income guide $1.275–1.375B, ~$9B customer prepayments, no new parent unsecured debt through 2027 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/coreweave-crwv-outlook-earnings-ai.html); [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-coreweave-nvidia-rally-fossil-tandy-leather-jump-5018694)). Peers up: NBIS +10.2%, APLD +6.4%, IREN +6.3% (CNBC); NVDA +4.9% to $177.08, MU +6.5%, AMD +6.4%, INTC +6.2%, AVGO +4.2% (Investing.com); MRVL +8% (Reuters). Anthropic set IPO terms, valuation up to $1.4T (Reuters).
2. **Rates.** Hot CPI keeps a December hike priced as certain, 11.5% odds of 50bp (CME FedWatch via Reuters); 10-yr briefly back above 5% Tue ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-11-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-treasurys-123445799.html)). Bond market closed today (Veterans Day).
3. **Oil/BTC.** Brent $92.45, WTI $86.53 early, bouncing off two-month lows on Hormuz tanker attacks ([Stockbiz](https://stockbiz.vn/en/news/november-11-markets-oil-rebounds-after-sharp-drop-gold-falls-back-into-the-red-soybeans-and-corn-surge/42731761)). BTC ~$74k, flat, ETF outflows a fourth day ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/11/bitcoin-sits-out-stock-rebound-as-etf-outflows-extend-to-fourth-day)).
4. **Other movers.** FOSL +17–20% on surprise profit and raised FY rev guide $980–990M ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-fossil-stock-surging-today-93CH-5018105)); NextNav +9% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)). Both small/low-priced gaps >5%: skip.

**Earnings ahead:** CTVA today AMC; NBIS 11/12 BMO; AMAT, CSCO 11/12 AMC; DIS 11/17 BMO. **Macro:** jobless claims Thu 8:30; Oct PPI Fri 8:30.

**Ideas (swing, long-only): no new calls.** Today's AI bounce is the same setup our 11/6 lesson flagged (first green day after a sector shock was noise), and NBIS/AMAT/CSCO report tomorrow; AI-hardware group avoid stays through 11/13 and gets revisited at Thu close. Carried holds unchanged (HUM med; others low, no re-adds).
